agent_final_answer:
Completed the comparison of the 2003 Acura CL vs the 2022 Acura ILX using cars.com's "Compare cars" tool (Research -> Compare cars side by side). Side-by-side highlights:

Spec | 2003 Acura CL | 2022 Acura ILX
Trim/Body | 2dr Cpe 3.2L | Sedan
Starting MSRP | $28,200 | $27,300
Consumer Rating | 4.6 | 5.0
Engine Type | Gas V6 | Premium Unleaded I-4
MPG | 20 City / 29 Hwy | 24 City / 34 Hwy
Horsepower | 225 hp | 201 hp
Drive Type | Front Wheel Drive | Front Wheel Drive
Seating Capacity | 4 | 5
Basic Warranty | 4 yr / 50,000 mi | 4 yr / 50,000 mi

Summary: The 2003 Acura CL is a more powerful V6 2-door coupe (225 hp) with a higher starting price ($28,200) and seats 4. The 2022 Acura ILX is a more fuel-efficient I-4 sedan (201 hp, 24 City / 34 Hwy mpg) with a lower starting price ($27,300), seats 5, and a higher consumer rating (5.0 vs 4.6). Both have front-wheel drive and a 4 yr / 50,000 mi basic warranty.
